standard_prerequisites.name: Decency and closed points
standard_prerequisites.use: Closed points of the special fibre are dense.

standard_prerequisites.name: Jacobian criterion over infinite fields
standard_prerequisites.use: Polynomials over infinite fields do not vanish identically on a nonempty open unless zero.

core_obligations: Reduce to an affine etale presentation U -> Spec(k) with x a non-closed point.
The closed points of U over k are dense and their residue fields are finite over k.
If only finitely many points specialized to x, the finitely many residue field conditions would cut U to a proper closed subset (infinite field argument), contradicting density.
Conclude infinitely many points of |X| specialize to x.
proof_roadmap: Reduction; density of closed points; finite-points contradiction via the infinite-field argument.
difficulty_reason: A counting argument whose substance is the infinite-field density contradiction.
